modmenu.descriptionTranslation.paintopti: Draws MC Paint paintings as one cached texture instead of thousands of letters, and never lets that cache grow past the memory limit you set.
paintoptimizer.options.title: Paint Optimizer
paintoptimizer.options.enabled.tooltip: Draws each MC Paint painting as one cached texture instead of thousands of letters. Off: the vanilla way, and the cache is freed.
paintoptimizer.options.cache_size.toolti: The most memory cached paintings may take. When it is full, the paintings you saw longest ago are removed first; they come back when you look at them again.
paintoptimizer.options.status.off: Off: paintings are drawn the vanilla way
paintoptimizer.options.status.mismatch: Paused: this resource pack sizes paintings differently
